summary: Second dependency-ordered slice: apps/web wired onto @agora/web-framework with a Host adapter layer (environment.ts, fixture.ts, index.ts), plus a narrow file-name-scoped apps/web test/config boundary-policy owner. App.tsx/main.tsx/FixtureControls.tsx/app.test.tsx are not wired in yet; that is the next slice. Preceding commit 9a8fe096605afaebc816227ebe42c3ceaafafd46 repoints the digestCanonical/canonicalJson node:crypto build edge (contracts/src/index.ts, apps/center, scripts/local-room-{client,service}.ts); it is a mechanical import-path fix with no new behavior, split out of this slice to stay within the 12-source-file bound, and verified by the same full pnpm check this outcome cites rather than its own red/green pair.
